original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated system completes 100 AC off/on cycles at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails, repeatedly returning all devices and services without unexpected errors or hangs.
original_method: Freeze a serial/slot inventory for all CPUs, DIMMs, storage, GPUs and network devices; establish a safe rated AC fixture, independent OOB observation and explicit off/discharge/on dwell plus boot/readiness deadlines; preserve initial logs; perform exactly 100 supervised cycles at controlled environmental/electrical margin; after every cycle record power-state transitions, POST/OS/BMC readiness, inventory and event deltas; abort on defined faults and finish with nominal restoration and full health comparison.
manual_activity: Qualified operator configures the full platform, chamber, rail margin and AC fixture, supervises all 100 cycles and restores normal operation.
required_inputs: Complete serial/slot inventory and expected enumerations
AC feed/fixture rating, commanded versus manual method and true-off proof
POST, BMC, OS and service readiness deadlines
Per-cycle error, device-loss, retry and abort policy
safety_requirements: Use an interlocked fixture rated for inrush and full population
Never silently retry a failed cycle
Preserve historical logs and mark cycle windows
Abort on smoke/odor, rail instability, repeated boot failure, thermal or device fault
agent_execution_scope: May compare per-cycle artifacts and inventory supplied by the operator
Must not switch mains power, control chamber/rails or decide DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve fixture, timing and readiness criteria
Triage any failure and determine verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct manual boundary; a remote command cannot prove AC removal or fixture safety.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved interlocked AC-cycle controller or documented manual sequence with per-cycle observation; no automatic retry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full population, 40C, -5% 5V/3.3V and exactly 100 AC cycles are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Maintain a cycle ledger that binds fixture state, true-off interval, readiness timestamps, inventory and log deltas to each of 100 cycles.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable inventory, inrush-capable fixture, explicit timing/readiness, no-retry rule and per-cycle recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final successful boot can hide intermittent lost devices or delayed readiness during earlier cycles.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: At negative rail margin and high temperature, inrush or marginal device initialization may fail only on particular cycles; aggregate final state is insufficient.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines full-population applicability, auto-power behavior, accepted expected power-loss events and whether one failed cycle terminates the run.
expected_evidence: Fixture/feed identity, rating and true-off measurements
100-entry cycle ledger with off/on and readiness timestamps
Final nominal inventory, log review and post-health

review_improvement: Requires cycle-by-cycle proof of full-population recovery instead of relying on a final boot and erased logs.
independent_technical_reasoning: AC cycling tests initialization paths and inrush behavior, not merely steady-state health. Marginal devices can disappear for one cycle and return later. A serial/slot inventory and cycle ledger are therefore necessary to prove no device was lost across all 100 negative-margin starts.
